name: dogfood-security-rbac-abac-app
description: Dogfood app v1.37-3 — a Casbin-style Authorization service (RBAC role hierarchy + ABAC attribute matching + combined policy engine + policy versioning + rollback) that drives an Authorization surface backed by @kiwa-test/security v0.1 authorization semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_POLICY_STORE_URL policy store) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory policy engine) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/security -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
